mapper.update: MERGE INTO HEALTH_DAILY_SUMMARY t USING ( WITH v AS ( SELECT CARD_CODE, CASE METRIC WHEN 'BLOOD_PRESSURE' THEN 'BP_SYS' ELSE METRIC END METRIC, VAL1 V FROM HEALTH_RECORD WHERE COLLECTED_AT >= #{from} AND COLLECTED_AT < #{to} UNION ALL SELECT CARD_CODE, 'BP_DIA', VAL2 FROM HEALTH_RECORD WHERE COLLECTED_AT >= #{from} AND COLLECTED_AT < #{to} AND METRIC = 'BLOOD_PRESSURE' AND VAL2 IS NOT NULL ), pr AS ( SELECT c.CARD_CODE, d.METRIC, NVL2(o.METRIC, o.GROUP_CODE, d.GROUP_CODE) RULE_GROUP, NVL2(o.METRIC, o.LOW_LIMIT, d.LOW_LIMIT) LOW_LIMIT, NVL2(o.METRIC, o.HIGH_LIMIT, d.HIGH_LIMIT) HIGH_LIMIT, NVL2(o.METRIC, o.ENABLED, d.ENABLED) ENABLED FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CARD_CODE FROM v) c LEFT JOIN POS_PERSON p ON p.CARD_CODE = c.CARD_CODE LEFT JOIN JOB_KIND_GROUP k ON k.JOB_KIND = p.JOB_KIND JOIN ALERT_RULE d ON d.GROUP_CODE = 'DEFAULT' LEFT JOIN ALERT_RULE o ON o.GROUP_CODE = k.GROUP_CODE AND o.METRIC = d.METRIC ) SELECT v.CARD_CODE, v.METRIC, MAX(v.V) MAX_V, MIN(v.V) MIN_V, ROUND(AVG(v.V), 2) AVG_V, COUNT(*) SAMPLE_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN pr.ENABLED = 0 OR ((pr.LOW_LIMIT IS NULL OR v.V >= pr.LOW_LIMIT) AND (pr.HIGH_LIMIT IS NULL OR v.V <= pr.HIGH_LIMIT)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) NORMAL_COUNT, pr.RULE_GROUP FROM v JOIN pr ON pr.CARD_CODE = v.CARD_CODE AND pr.METRIC = v.METRIC GROUP BY v.CARD_CODE, v.METRIC, pr.RULE_GROUP ) s ON (t.STAT_DATE = #{statDate} AND t.CARD_CODE = s.CARD_CODE AND t.METRIC = s.METRIC) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.MAX_V = s.MAX_V, t.MIN_V = s.MIN_V, t.AVG_V = s.AVG_V, t.SAMPLE_COUNT = s.SAMPLE_COUNT, t.NORMAL_COUNT = s.NORMAL_COUNT, t.RULE_GROUP = s.RULE_GROUP, t.UPDATED_AT = LOCALTIMESTAMP(0) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (STAT_DATE, CARD_CODE, METRIC, MAX_V, MIN_V, AVG_V, SAMPLE_COUNT, NORMAL_COUNT, RULE_GROUP) VALUES (#{statDate}, s.CARD_CODE, s.METRIC, s.MAX_V, s.MIN_V, s.AVG_V, s.SAMPLE_COUNT, s.NORMAL_COUNT, s.RULE_GROUP)
